text: Residents from Bainbridge Avenue have been contacting my office for years asking for the current strict parking restrictions on the north side of the street to be alleviated between Bathurst Street and 20A Bainbridge Avenue. Last year my office polled the street and we received support for the change. Transportation Services has been working with my office regarding the changes to the parking regulations on Bainbridge Avenue and is in support of the recommendations.

North York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect from 7:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the north and south sides of Bainbridge Avenue, between Bathurst Street and Yeomans Road. 2. Prohibited parking from 7:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the south side of Bainbridge Avenue, between Bathurst Street and Yeomans Road. 3. Prohibited parking from 7:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the north side of Bainbridge Avenue, between a point 133 metres west of Bathurst Street and Yeomans Road.
